pages.title: Frozen Photon
pages.text: Light that reached the event horizon and stopped there, from an outside view, redshifted almost to nothing. It is barely visible and very cold, the faintest red glow, and it never quite fades away. Warming it does nothing.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Tidal Horrors dropped these near the horizon. Later, I made them in the Neutron Star Forge by firing stellar plasma through infall rock against a neutronium plate.

Made in $(item)Neutron Star Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Frozen Light Ore$(), in veins through the black hole interior.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Tidal Horror.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Einstein-Rosen Core, Stress-Energy Tensor.
